checks: Canonical structural PASS; 9 deterministic logic fixtures; 2 real Chromium fixtures / 6 assertions
Focused Node and Chromium tests passed before source commit; responsive, invalid-input, Unicode and supported output-action checks. See tests/tools/password-generator.
Local verification only; clipboard/download simulated; no public release claim.

logic.scope: Deterministic inline JavaScript logic, executed in Node with explicit fixtures.

browser.scope: Real Chromium DOM; clipboard/download APIs simulated; external HTTP(S) blocked.

qrcodegen.use: Local QR encoding only. No transport/storage calls; no service or production build dependency.
qrcodegen.build: TypeScript 5.9.3: tsc qrcodegen.ts --target es2015 --lib es2015,dom --outFile qrcodegen.js --removeComments false

wordlist.version: EFF large English list dated 2016-07-18; pinned by SHA-256

wordlist.attribution: Electronic Frontier Foundation; Joseph Bonneau. Dice codes removed in the generated JavaScript wrapper; word order/content unchanged.
wordlist.use: Local passphrase generation. No external wordlist fetch or telemetry.

limitations: Local headless Chromium; no Safari/Firefox, physical-device, screen-reader or native-dialog certification.
User inputs processed locally; hosting/CDN requests and optional consent-based site analytics are separate.
